title: fix(lint)!: refuse an app nav `visible` over the CEL parse budget
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XC4xfxw32gxAmvNzpJ9zoHk)_

Fixes #28726

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a navigation entry's `visible` grammar or the CEL parse budgets; the refusal carries its own fix and its `os explain visibility-predicate-over-budget` entry.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：应用导航项的 `visible` 如果是合法 CEL 但超出解析预算（例如 90 段 `||` 链，超过 `maxAstNodes` 256），现在和同样大小的页面 `visibleWhen` 一样被拒，规则还是 `visibility-predicate-over-budget`：保存、草稿诊断、发布、`os validate` 四处同一条结论。没有新规则、新解析器或新上限。
- **为什么改**：先实测了控制台：这种导航项保存、草稿显示 valid、照常发布，到了控制台被整项隐藏（日志 `[bounds] Exceeded maxAstNodes (256)`，withholding），旁边一段的同款谓词照常显示。#28663 只给导航项接了语法那一支，没接超预算那一支。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只收紧写入口，已存的应用照常加载；仓内语料只有 1 个导航 `visible`，远低于预算，零命中。回滚即撤回 `@objectstack/lint` 的这次改动。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`（`walkNavPredicates` 的分支和新增的 `navOverBudgetFinding`）；`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`（over-budget 新增的导航段落）；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.app-nav-visible-predicate-writes.test.ts`（#28726 用例块）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.app-nav-visible-predicate-writes.test.ts`，预期 27/27 通过（main 上新增的 8 条红）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`, the nav walker only.** `walkNavPredicates` already asked `celRefusal` (formula's `parseCelToAstWithReason`, the one front end, `DEFAULT_LIMITS`) for every nav `visible` and kept only its `kind: 'syntax'` answer. It now keeps both: a `kind: 'bounds'` answer becomes `visibility-predicate-over-budget`, the id a page `visibleWhen` of the same size already gets, at `navigation[].visible`, `areas[].navigation[].visible` and every entry's `children[].visible`, located at the key. No second rule id, no second parser, no new limits.
- **The finding.** A new `navOverBudgetFinding` builds it: the verdict sentence is the element one (`checkElement`'s bounds arm, same `boundName`) with the nav consequence clause `NAV_SURFACE` already carries ("so it never evaluates and the entry is hidden from every viewer"). The remedy is nav-shaped, because a nav entry binds no `record`: the element hint's `record.f in […]` collapse and "a formula/rollup field on the object" are rewrites a nav author cannot make. It says: collapse an `||` chain into one list test, e.g. `current_user.positions.exists(p, p in ['a', 'b', …])`, (one example, at most 200 characters, pinned); the alternative of gating the entry on one `current_user.can('OBJECT', 'read')` check is in `os explain visibility-predicate-over-budget`. Both shapes were evaluated in the console on the head boot: each entry rendered, no fault line.
- **`checkElement` is untouched**, so page and view wording is byte-identical (the claim's file surface is the nav walker; #28725 works in the predicate rules in parallel). The element bounds arm and the new nav builder share `boundName` and `NAV_SURFACE`; folding the two message builders into one is a mechanical follow-up once #28725 has landed.
- **`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`.** `visibility-predicate-over-budget` gains the nav paragraph (falls CLOSED, hidden from every viewer, the nav-shaped rewrite). The `visibility-predicate-syntax` nav paragraph said "Only the syntax is judged on a navigation entry", which this change makes false; it now says only whether the predicate parses is judged there, a size overrun being `visibility-predicate-over-budget`.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28726-nav-visible-over-budget.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/lint`, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines and `Skills-docs:`. It carries a sentence superseding the "only the syntax is judged" line of the pending #28663 changeset, which this PR does not edit.

The save door, draft `_diagnostics` and publish read `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules`, and the family already declares `app` since #28663, so all four doors move with no `metadata-protocol` source edit.

## Tests

- **Red first, at base `8bceb6a2`** (lint built from base): the new `#28726` block in `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.app-nav-visible-predicate-writes.test.ts` failed 8 of its 12 (27 in the file, 19 passed). The reds: the 90-clause chain at the app door and in `os validate` (`runAuthoringRules('validate')`) for top-level, inside an area and inside a group (6), the `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope, and the nav-shaped remedy. Controls green on base: a 51-clause chain (the largest the front end admits; 52 overruns) at all three sites, and a page `visibleWhen` of the same 90-clause size keeping its own finding.
- **Protocol-level, red on base:** two new CASES rows in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (top-level and a group child: the draft saves, reads `valid: false` with the publish's words, publish refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA`), a path test (`navigation.0.children.0.visible`, code `visibility-predicate-over-budget`; a 51-clause chain reads `{ valid: true }`), and in `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` an active app save refused 422 with the build's finding key by key (`rule`, `where`, `path`, `message`, `hint`) and nothing stored, plus a 51-clause control that lands. Base: 4 failed, 22 passed.
- **Green at head:** lint file 27/27, the two protocol files 258/258.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, from committed HEAD f45609e0)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `    if (source && refusal) {` in the nav walker with a guard that drops `refusal.kind === 'bounds'` behind the opaque marker `ABL_28726`: anchor 1 → 0, blob `aa46aafe8c1f` → `ea2b20654c50`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint ABL_28726` exit 0 (marker in dist). Lint file: 8 failed, 19 passed. Protocol files (they read lint through `dist/`): 4 failed, 254 passed. Restored: blob equals HEAD `aa46aafe8c1f`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, then 27/27 and 258/258 again. Script and log: `pm-orders/server/evidence/28726/ablate.sh`, `ablations.txt`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured first (ruling 1).** Stock showcase boot at base `8bceb6a2` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase dev -- --fresh -p 4611`), signed in as the seeded admin, a writable probe package installed, an app saved as a draft with three nav entries and published: `nav_control` (`features.cloudManaged != true`), `nav_over` (that clause 90 times joined by `||`), and a group whose only child holds the same chain. The draft read `{ "valid": true }`, `publish-drafts` answered `published`, an active save of a twin answered 200. In Chromium (Playwright, session cookie from the same sign-in), `/_console/apps/qa_budget_app` drew the sidebar with **Control Entry Small only**: `Over Budget Entry` absent, the group absent (its only child withheld). The console logged `A visibility predicate could not be evaluated - node "app-shell:visible" … Reason: [bounds] Exceeded maxAstNodes (256)`. Premise holds; the PM's mechanism assumption holds in code too: `ExpressionProvider.tsx#evaluateNavigationVisibility` withholds on a fault, and `ExpressionEvaluator#evaluateCelCondition` evaluates through formula's `evalFieldPredicate`, built on `CEL_ENV_OPTIONS.limits = DEFAULT_LIMITS`, the limits `celRefusal` parses under.
- **Corpus (migration note).** The shipped corpus carries 1 nav `visible` (`examples/app-crm`, `current_user.can('crm_opportunity', 'read')`), far under budget: **0** would now be refused. The served apps on a stock showcase boot carry none; `os validate` on `examples/app-crm`, `app-showcase` and `app-todo` at head: each `Validation passed`, 0 over-budget findings.
- **Rule-explanation edit beyond the over-budget paragraph:** the syntax entry's nav paragraph sentence this change made false (named above).
- **`area:studio` reach:** Studio's app editor saves through the same metadata door, so it shows the refusal the door gives; no Studio code moved.

## Verification

- **Live probe, base vs head** (`pm-orders/server/evidence/28726/probe.sh`, `live-probe.txt`): same steps on a fresh boot per tree (`-p 4611` base, `-p 4612` head, lint rebuilt from each).
  - base: draft `_diagnostics` `{ "valid": true }`; `publish-drafts` `outcome: published`; active `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/qa_budget_app2` HTTP 200.
  - head: draft `_diagnostics` `valid: false` with two errors, `navigation.1.visible` and `navigation.2.children.0.visible`, code `visibility-predicate-over-budget`, message "visibility predicate is syntactically valid CEL but overruns the `maxAstNodes` budget (platform limit 256), so it never evaluates and the entry is hidden from every viewer"; `publish-drafts` `outcome: refused`, `INVALID_METADATA`; active `PUT` HTTP 422 with the same two issues.
- **`os validate`** (`evidence/28726/osvalidate.sh`): `examples/app-crm` with its nav `visible` planted to the 90-clause chain: head exits 1 with `rule: visibility-predicate-over-budget at apps[0].navigation[1].children[0].visible`; base (lint built from `8bceb6a2`) `✓ Validation passed`. Plant and lint restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Package suites at `238ee238`** (after merging `origin/main` `e735b79e`): `@objectstack/lint` 186 files / 7761 tests passed, typecheck exit 0; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 293 passed, 4 skipped files / 21992 passed, 26 skipped tests, typecheck exit 0 (one `&&` lock verdict, command-exit 0); `pnpm exec eslint packages/lint packages/metadata-protocol --no-inline-config` exit 0.
- **Derived gates at `238ee238`:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 59 families; all 59 run, `--ran` verdict: "59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Two needed a second run, both green on it: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3 on the shallow clone, green after fetching its fixture commit) and `check:type-check-debt` (exit 3, lock queue-timeout while the dogfood battery held the lock; green under the lock). Record: `pm-orders/server/28726-gates-ran.txt`.
- **Dogfood battery at `238ee238`** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 376 passed, 1 skipped / Tests 3045 passed, 17 skipped.
- **CI** runs the full farm on this PR; `test:repo` (Test Core) is CI's, not run locally.
- `origin/main` moved 7 commits after the gate run (`7e6e8a46`..`3ee6af44`, including #28714 in `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`); `git merge-tree` against it is clean and touches none of this PR's files. #28725 had not landed; the second of the two to land merges `origin/main`.
